prompts.main:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production transparent animation atlas for STARLIT-GUILD, Mira the adult moon healer.
Input image 1 is Mira's latest CHARACTER AND COSTUME REFERENCE ONLY. Input image 2 is the new Aria atlas, STYLE / CHIBI PROPORTIONS ONLY; don't draw Aria or green outfits.
Generate a brand-new polished chibi Mira animation sheet, exactly 16 full-body drawings in 4 columns and 4 rows. Approx. 2.2 heads tall, oversized head and small compact body matching Aria's scale, clean readable outlines and broad soft matte painted color areas suitable for 90px game display.
IDENTITY: muted pale grey-lavender hair gathered into a compact BRAIDED UPDO at back of head, with short loose face framing wisps only. NO long loose hair, flowing ponytail, long braid or waist length hair. Soft tired grey-violet eyes, heavy upper eyelids, subtle grey-violet shadows under eyes (not red blush), pale complexion, patient gentle faint smile even when tired. Preserve approachable adult healer persona, not lively child.
COSTUME: white opaque bodice, small dark blue neck ribbon, light white and pale blue-lavender off shoulder outer robe with modest gold motifs, brown waist medical pouches. Light layered robe, small visible sandal feet with dark straps, no bulky boots. White flowers and golden crescent moon hair ornament matching reference. Gold crescent topped staff with pale lavender orb and white flowers; simplify tiny hanging ornaments for readability. Hair and cloth have gentle matte shading, no glossy stripe highlights.
All figures face RIGHT in consistent three-quarter side view. Identical head size and body proportions across all 16 drawings; distinct hand and leg poses. Every staff, robe, hand, foot must be fully inside its own cell, separated with generous transparent gutters. Staff put aside in gathering and work frames, not floating. NO large magical effects.
Exact reading order:
Row1: four walk cycle frames holding staff: forward contact, passing, opposite contact, opposite passing, alternate legs and robe swing visibly.
Row2: four casting/healing frames: ready with staff, raise staff, extend staff toward right, return from cast; distinct arm/staff angle differences.
Row3: col1 neutral idle with gentle tired eyes open; col2 kneel to collect herbs; col3 second kneeling herb pose placing leaves into pouch; col4 recoil/hurt leaning back, surprised eyes.
Row4: col1 brief closed eye idle blink (same pose as idle); col2 recover from hurt; col3 lean forward push cargo hands extending RIGHT, palms forward, NO cart; col4 second push stride hands still forward, different leg position.
Real transparent alpha background. No checkerboard graphic, no labels/text/numbers/grid, no ground/shadow, no glow, detached particles or separate objects. Exactly16 individual Mira figures. Square atlas.
